messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Model.matrix() ?

Yes, it's called getDesign, but it is meant for internal use. If you really want to use it, you could checkout out the source code on github and use

unmarked:::getDesign(someUnmarkedFrame, someFormula)

Note that there are specific methods for many of the unmarkedFrame classes.

Richard
